title: Training Spiritual Ears
headline: A 15-Minute Practice for Listening to God
tagline: Silence isn’t the goal. Relationship is.
seo_title: How to Listen to God: A 15-Minute Practice (Luke 10:39) | TheWrkShop
seo_description: Listening to God isn't emptying your mind; it's filling it with His Word. A simple 15-minute practice for men from Luke 10:39.
verse_text: Mary sat at the Lord’s feet listening to what He said.

scriptures.text: Mary sat at the Lord’s feet listening to what He said.

items: Most men expect listening to happen naturally.
Scripture presents it as something cultivated.
Hebrews teaches that mature believers have their discernment trained through constant practice.
Listening develops like every other spiritual discipline.

blocks.text: Spend fifteen uninterrupted minutes with God.

items: Listening to God isn’t emptying your mind.
It is filling your mind with His Word until His Spirit illuminates it.
God most often speaks through the Scriptures He has already given.
Silence simply makes room for relationship.
Mary wasn’t merely listening to teaching.
She was sitting before the One who is the Truth.
